attributes.target: frame id or _top/_self/_parent keyword; see frameKeywordRules

elements.name: turbo-stream

attributes.targets: CSS selector through shared CSS3 parser
attributes.method: replace/update: morph; refresh: replace or morph

elements.content: HTML template element; no execution of its contents

attributes.src: source URL fact; no EventSource or WebSocket connection

streamRules: replace/update may name method=morph; refresh may name method/scroll and request-id without a target. Other actions describe target(s) and template content statically, never perform mutations.

frameKeywordRules._self: Frame-origin navigation: the current frame controller looks up the literal document id _self before falling back to the current frame. An enabled turbo-frame with id=_self takes precedence; retain its authored definition/reference/rename relation. Without that literal frame, the current frame is selected even when its target is _top; retain the current-frame relation, with no missing-frame diagnostic or literal-ID rename relation. A disabled literal frame prevents interception rather than falling back to the current frame. Document-origin navigation: the redirector selects only an enabled literal turbo-frame with id=_self; without one, it selects no frame. Partial target population remains unknown.
frameKeywordRules._parent: Frame-origin navigation: the current frame controller resolves the nearest ancestor turbo-frame from its parent element, without literal-id precedence. With no ancestor, that controller does not intercept; no missing-frame diagnostic or authored frame-id rename relation. With an ancestor, retain the ancestor relation and its disabled-state condition. Document-origin navigation: the frame redirector resolves data-turbo-frame by literal document id, including _parent, selecting only an enabled turbo-frame. Retain the authored definition/reference/rename relation to that literal ID. The selected frame controller then resolves its own ancestor, falling back to the selected frame if no ancestor exists. An absent or disabled literal _parent frame is not selected by the redirector; do not infer an ancestor relation or diagnose a missing reserved target. Partial ancestry or target population remains unknown.

meta.turbo-prefetch-cache-time: number conversion of literal milliseconds; zero/NaN fall back to the pinned default, without simulating a cache

standardHtml: view-transition meta remain shared HTML facts
partial: Template holes and Ruby helpers preserve unknown tokens/population completeness; never fabricate frame ids or selector matches.
